ambiguity_notes: Tie-break rule within rajayoga rule 2; blemish assessment is a lordship computation outside the DSL.

ambiguity_notes: Ordinal weighting of functional benefic lordships; informational ranking, no chart condition.

consequent.text: Gradation among benefic lords: 9th > 5th; 10th > 7th > 4th (least).

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Adjust judgment for the native's age, position, status and sex.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Weigh exaltation and debilitation of the house lords.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Weigh the house lord's strength, aspects, conjunctions and location.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

quote: 3. The natural qualities of the house, of its lord and the planets in it or having aspects.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

consequent.text: Weigh the Navamsa situation of the house lord and of its dispositor.

quote: 6. The situation—favourable or adverse—of the house-lord or the lord in whose house the particular house-lord is situated, in the Navamsa.

ambiguity_notes: One of the eight enumerated considerations for judging a Bhava; procedural, applied per-house by the astrologer.

quote: 4. Whether the influence has been altered by any yogas occurring in any particular house or houses.

ambiguity_notes: Procedural directive; which 'other appropriate diagrams' apply per house is left to the astrologer.

consequent.text: Judge a house from the Rasi, the Navamsa and other appropriate divisional charts, not the Rasi alone.

quote: In examining a house due importance should be given not only to the Rasi but also to the Navamsa and other appropriate diagrams.

consequent.text: Benefic lords: lagna lord (unless the Moon), trikona lords (5, 9), and kendra lords (4, 7, 10) when they are not natural benefics.

quote: In any horoscope the benefics or benefic lords are :— (1) First house lord, other than the Moon; (2) the 5th and 9th lords (Thrikonadhipathis); (3) and (4) lords of the 4th, 7th and 10th when they do not happen to be natural benefics.

ambiguity_notes: Lordship-classification rule; see functional_benefic_lords_general for the proposed impl.

consequent.text: Malefic lords: lords of 3, 6, 11; and kendra lords (4, 7, 10) when they are natural benefics (Kendradhipatya dosha).

quote: The malefics or malefic lords in a horoscope are :— (1) Lords of the 3rd, 6th and 11th houses; (2) lords of the 4th, 7th and 10th houses (Kendradhipathis) if they happen to be natural benefics.

ambiguity_notes: Lordship-classification rule; luminaries exempted from 2nd/8th/12th lordship blemish.

quote: The neutrals in a horoscope are:—(1) The Moon—when he is lord of Lagna, (2) the Sun or the Moon as the 8th lord, (3) the Sun or the Moon as the lords of the 2nd and 12th.
